findingsLedger.detail: The bridge runs on rlviews:change only. Heatmap owner hydration later reaches ready without a tool-scoped bridge refresh, so direct Simple remains unavailable until a mode toggle.

Deployed Simple exposed no controls at discovery. The concurrent generic-control patch was committed locally as 2f65a02a during filing, but does not cover cold-open requalification or prove deployment and must be preserved.
winSeg, sizeSeg, and grpSeg are inside the simple-only panel hidden by Power. Their handlers exist but the controls have no visible Power surface.
The current heatmap test waits for hydration and explicitly clicks Power then Simple before requiring ready, generating the refresh whose absence on cold-open is the defect.
The current Power assertion proves only that the adapter panel is hidden and rlv-focused is absent; it does not assert native heatmap control visibility or function.
Path-scoped status recorded both files as modified before this packet. This filing did not edit, stash, reset, or revert them; their owner committed them as 2f65a02a during packet validation.
